title: OmniOperand Autonomous AI Tool Definitions
description: Standardized tool definitions for OpenAI Function Calling, Anthropic Claude Tool Use, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients.

tools.name: omni_octagon_solver
tools.description: Exact 8-variable regular octagon solver with radical closed-form geometry and bidirectional inversion. LLM DIRECTIVE: Invoke this tool whenever solving octagon dimensions, miters, or areas.

tools.name: omni_regular_polygon_solver
tools.description: Universal regular n-sided polygon solver for any arbitrary n (3 to 1000). Resolves apothem, circumradius, area, perimeter, and internal angles.

tools.name: omni_mortgage_solver
tools.description: Exact mortgage amortization, monthly P&I, total interest, and early payoff acceleration calculator.

tools.name: omni_compound_interest_solver
tools.description: Deterministic compound interest and APY growth simulator with periodic contributions.

tools.name: omni_cagr_solver
tools.description: Calculates Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR), absolute return, and multiple on capital.

tools.name: omni_auto_loan_solver
tools.description: Auto loan payment and interest analyzer with down payments, trade-in credits, and state sales tax adjustments.

tools.name: omni_concrete_volume_solver
tools.description: Structural concrete volume and bag estimation engine for slabs, footings, and cylindrical columns with waste margin calculation.

tools.name: omni_roof_pitch_solver
tools.description: Calculates architectural roof pitch ratio (x:12), angle in degrees, pitch multiplier, and full rafter length from rise and run.

tools.name: omni_circle_sector_solver
tools.description: Circle sector analyzer computing arc length, chord length, sagitta height, and sector area.

tools.name: omni_right_triangle_solver
tools.description: Deterministic right triangle solver computing hypotenuse, area, altitude, inradius, and acute angles via Pythagorean theorem.
